lines.text: It's called survivorship bias. And it's the entire business model of the success video. You only ever hear from the guy who made it. Nobody films the morning routine of the guy whose dropshipping store sold three phone cases.

lines.text: The evidence is fairly boring. Work hard on things that matter. Rest on purpose. Sleep is not for the weak. Sleep is for people who'd like to still be productive on Thursday.
